title: Blog post predicting that within a decade we will acknowledge non-human intelligence

tellings.quote: i think that we're going to be stay in a decade from now where we acknowledge that we are not the only life forms that are intelligent and super intelligent on this planet

plain: Deep Prasad, a young researcher interested in how UFOs might work, says he wrote a blog post called "Curiosity as a Time Capsule." In it, he says, he predicted that within about ten years, so by around 2032, people will accept that humans are not the only intelligent, even super intelligent, life on Earth.
